Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd's subsidiary, GFCL EV Products, has incorporated GFCL EV New Age Materials SAOC in Oman.
The new entity will focus on manufacturing and trading battery chemicals; GFCL EV Products holds a 99% stake.

GFL's March 2026 net sales rose 6.6% YoY to Rs 0.9 cr; net profit surged 239.7%.
GFL shares closed at Rs 46.45, offering 23% 6-month and 26.3% 12-month returns.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹52.26 (up from ₹49.71 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹50.4b (up 6.3% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.78b (up 5.8% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 11%. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 26% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 3% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited at the board meeting held on May 26, 2026 announced that the Board has recommended Final Dividend @ 300 % i.e., INR 3.00 per Equity Share of face value of INR 1 each for the Financial Year 2025-26, subject to the approval of the Shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

news.title: Consensus revenue estimates fall by 10%
news.body: The consensus outlook for revenues in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹54.6b to ₹49.2b. EPS estimate fell from ₹73.07 to ₹58.79 per share. Net income forecast to grow 31% next year vs 24% growth forecast for Chemicals industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹3,930 to ₹3,657. Share price was steady at ₹3,411 over the past week.

news.title: FLUOROCHEM: Fair Outlook As Battery Materials Venture And Governance Changes Shape Future
news.body: Analysts have adjusted their price target for Gujarat Fluorochemicals from ₹3,000 to about ₹3,139.94, reflecting updated assumptions on fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E expectations. What's in the News IFC, a member of the World Bank Group, is investing US$50 million in GFCL EV Products Limited through compulsorily convertible instruments to build what is described as India's first integrated battery materials facility, focused on battery chemicals with backward integration into key raw materials (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹9.29 (down from ₹11.47 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹11.4b (flat on 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.02b (down 19% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.9% (down from 11% in 3Q 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 7.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 40%. Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 32% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 4% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
